objections.claim: The source-release assembly remains nondeterministic. It extracts `git archive`, injects generated files, and repacks while fixing order, owner, group, and mtime, but it never normalizes member permissions. Extraction and generated-file modes vary with `umask`, and tar records those modes; GNU tar explicitly identifies `--mode` as necessary to eliminate permission variance ([GNU tar reproducibility guidance](https://www.gnu.org/s/tar/manual/html_chapter/Formats.html)). Two builds on the same runner and under the same umask can therefore byte-match while a clean rebuild under another valid umask produces a different tarball digest, so the stated oracle would not discriminate this blocker-6 failure. Specify deterministic modes while preserving Git executable/symlink semantics and add a regression that builds under distinct umasks and requires identical final bytes.
